headline: Callahan's Passage Turns Wholly Warden as Expanse Fray Rages
war_summary: Since our last edition went to press, Callahan's Passage has swung wholesale: every one of its ten posts, Colonial-held at the morning filing, now flies Warden colours. Nineteen actions marked the day there, Crumbling Post and the Crumbling Passage the busiest ground, and the latest hour's toll — near sixty casualties apiece — was still climbing as this dispatch was filed. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace: sixty-three actions in twenty-four hours, Wightwalk alone worked over twenty-eight times, the count now reading four Warden posts to two Colonial, with three grounds reduced to no-man's-land. Mooring County's Colonial gains have ebbed to two of twelve, Gravekeeper's Holdfast drawing twenty exchanges, last word arriving at mid-morning. The Nevish Line, now six Warden posts to two, has been quiet since before seven. Overnight skirmishing at Fisherman's Row and Kuura Strand ceased some hours since, both maps settled under a single flag. In Marban Hollow and the Dead Lands the casualty columns climb by attrition alone. Day 545; thirty-four victory towns remain unclaimed and no victor is named.
